mapper.select: SELECT event_id, category_id, title, start_dt, end_dt, ann_count FROM event WHERE event_se = 'EVT' AND start_dt <= CURDATE() AND end_dt >= CURDATE() ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{count}
SELECT event_id, e.category_id, e.author_id, e.title, e.ann_count, e.start_dt, e.end_dt, e.views, e.like_count FROM event e WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND event_id < #{eventId} AND event_se = 'EVT' ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND event_id > #{eventId} AND event_se = 'EVT' ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event (event_se, category_id, author_id, title, ann_count, start_dt, end_dt) VALUES ('EVT', #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{annCount}, #{startDt}, #{endDt})
mapper.update: UPDATE event SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, ann_count = #{annCount}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
